question: If the angle between the direction of current flowing through a conductor and the direction of magnetic field is zero, the force (F) acting on the conductor will be __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zero**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **When the angle between the direction of current flowing through a conductor and the direction of the magnetic field is zero,** the force (F) acting on the conductor will be at its maximum.
 
• **The force acting on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field is given by the formula:**
 
 
• **F=BILsinθ**
 
 
 
• **Where:**
 
 
• **B is the magnetic field strength,**
 
• **I is the current,**
 
• **L is the length of the conductor in the magnetic field,**
 
• θ is the angle between the magnetic field and the direction of current.
 
 
 
• If the angle θ is zero (i.e., the current and magnetic field are parallel), then
 
 
• sin(0∘)=0
 
 
 
• So, the force " id="MathJax-Element-2-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-1-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-15-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-21-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-29-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-47-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">" id="MathJax-Element-23-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">
 
 

 FF becomes **zero**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The maximum force is experienced when the angle is 90o, but in this case, the sinø becomes 1, which is the maximum value.
 
• However, in practical scenarios, it is not always possible to have the conductor perpendicular to the magnetic field.
 
• When the angle is 0 degrees, the force experienced is zero because sinø is zero.
 
• When the angle is 180 degrees, the force experienced is also zero because sinø is again zero.
 
• Therefore, the maximum force is experienced when the angle between the direction of the current in the conductor and the direction of the magnetic field is 45 degrees because the sin45 is the maximum value of 0.707.
